entities.summary: Kate Hardie is an English actress. She is best known for her roles in The Krays, “Open Fire 1998” (film) Mona Lisa and the 2016 Channel 4 original series National Treasure. Hardie's stage name is derived from those of both her parents: Jean Hart and Bill Oddie.
